blocks.html: This documentation provides a reference to the `maybeListTaxRateRuleIdsStep`. It belongs to the `@medusajs/medusa/core-flows` package.
This step lists the rules to update in a tax rate update object.

children.name: tax_rate_ids
children.description: The IDs of the tax rates to retrieve their rules.

children.name: update
children.description: The data to update in the tax rates.

children.name: code
children.description: The code of the tax rate.

children.name: name
children.description: The name of the tax rate.

children.name: rules
children.description: The rules of the tax rate.

children.name: reference
children.description:
The snake-case name of the data model that the tax rule references.
For example, `product`.

Learn more in [this guide](https://docs.medusajs.com/resources/commerce-modules/tax/tax-rates-and-rules#override-tax-rates-with-rules).

children.name: reference_id
children.description:
The ID of the record of the data model that the tax rule references.
For example, `prod_123`.

Learn more in [this guide](https://docs.medusajs.com/resources/commerce-modules/tax/tax-rates-and-rules#override-tax-rates-with-rules).

children.name: metadata
children.description: Holds custom data in key-value pairs.

children.name: created_by
children.description:
Who created the tax rate rule. For example, the ID of the
user that created it.

children.name: is_default
children.description: Whether the tax rate is default.

children.name: is_combinable
children.description:
Whether the tax rate is combinable.

Learn more [here](https://docs.medusajs.com/resources/commerce-modules/tax/tax-rates-and-rules#combinable-tax-rates).

children.name: metadata
children.description: Holds custom data in key-value pairs.
